references.notes: Full text read via WebFetch of the AAAAI-hosted PDF of the article (in-press version, same DOI); metadata from PubMed. WebFetch quotes are capped at 125 characters, so long passages are quoted in part. claims.text: Anaphylaxis may progress rapidly, within minutes, from one severity grade to another

claims.quote: Anaphylaxis is highly likely when any one of the following 3 criteria are fulfilled

claims.text: Meeting diagnostic criteria is not required before using epinephrine
claims.quote: We suggest that meeting diagnostic criteria for anaphylaxis is not required before the use of epinephrine.

claims.text: Anaphylaxis may occur without typical skin features
claims.quote: it may occur without typical skin features, circulatory shock, or compromised breathing being present.

claims.text: Biphasic second phase within 1 to 48 hours after full resolution of first symptoms
claims.quote: occur within 1 to 48 h from complete resolution of the initial symptoms or examination findings

claims.text: Consider mastocytosis evaluation in adults with severe insect sting anaphylaxis or recurrent idiopathic anaphylaxis
claims.quote: Evaluation for mastocytosis, including a bone marrow biopsy, should be considered for adult patients with severe insect sting anaphylaxis or recurrent idiopathic anaphylaxis.

claims.text: Routinely prescribe EAIs to higher-risk patients; shared decision-making for lower-risk patients
claims.quote: We suggest clinicians routinely prescribe EAIs to patients at higher risk of anaphylaxis. ... we suggest that clinicians engage in a shared decisionmaking process

claims.text: Choose among EAIs by dosage, needle length, affordability, access and patient preference
claims.quote: consider dosage, needle length, affordability, access, and patient treatment preferences

claims.quote: clinicians consider a patient’s risk factors for severe anaphylaxis, their values and preferences, and contextual factors

claims.text: Dose 0.01 mg/kg, max 0.3 mg for children and teenagers and 0.5 mg for adults

claims.text: Give epinephrine at the first sign or symptom of suspected anaphylaxis
